sdg:Requirement.sdg:Description: Request for evidence that the person (proof subject) qualifies for the profession of reference under the general acquired rights provisions of Article 23 of Directive 2005/36/EC and, where applicable, under the relevant profession-specific acquired rights provision (Articles 27, 30, 33, 37, 39, 43, or 49).
